text_blocks.snippet: You can end isolation after COVID-19 at least 5 days after symptom onset if you have been fever-free for at least 24 hours without fever-reducing medication, and other symptoms are improving. You should also wear a high-quality mask around others through day 10.

list.snippet: Symptom onset: Day 0 is the first day you experience symptoms.
Fever: You must be fever-free for at least 24 hours without taking fever-reducing medication.
Other symptoms: Other symptoms should be improving.
Masking: Wear a high-quality mask around others through day 10.
Test-based strategy: A test-based strategy can be used to determine if you can remove your mask sooner.
Reoccurrence: If symptoms worsen or return, you should restart the isolation period at day 0.
